promotion_gates.threshold_criterion: >= 30 days continuous observations, >= 80% daily coverage, 0 synthetic fills
promotion_gates.observed_metric: 173.9h total span, 71.3 min active operation (0.684% coverage)
promotion_gates.reason: Hardware operated in 5 sporadic bursts over 7 days with gaps up to 89.3h. Zero continuous 24h days exist.

promotion_gates.threshold_criterion: Must outperform Persistence Baseline on >= 3 of 4 parameters on held-out test split
promotion_gates.observed_metric: Outperformed Persistence on 1 parameter (Turbidity: 2.06 vs 3.46 NTU). Severely underperformed on TDS (160.07 vs 0.20 ppm, 796x worse) and Temp (0.76 vs 0.13 °C, 5.7x worse).
promotion_gates.reason: Persistence strongly beats LSTM on high-frequency quasi-static telemetry (TDS, Temp, pH).

promotion_gates.observed_metric: TDS normalized shift = 0.970 training sigmas (Train: 1013.8 ± 1039.1 ppm; Test: 5.56 ± 0.37 ppm)
promotion_gates.reason: Extreme covariate shift between saline bench calibration in train split and clean tap water in test split.

promotion_gates.threshold_criterion: Training cadence must equal target forecast horizon (T_train == 24h)
promotion_gates.observed_metric: Training cadence = ~32 seconds; target horizon = 24 hours
promotion_gates.reason: Model predicts next 32s step, cannot extrapolate 24h daily trends.

registered_models.approval_notes: Failed Data Coverage, Baseline, Covariate Stability, and Horizon Cadence gates. Retained as offline research benchmark only.

registered_models.intended_horizon: Experimental next-step extrapolation (~33s on live stream)

promotion_gates.threshold_criterion: Must be trained on verified real hardware sensor data (not synthetic/simulated)
promotion_gates.observed_metric: Trained on SIMULATED_DEVELOPMENT (200 simulated daily observations)
promotion_gates.reason: Simulated dataset does not reflect actual ESP32/TCS34725 hardware calibration noise or physical tank dynamics.

promotion_gates.threshold_criterion: Outperforms persistence baseline on simulated validation/test benchmarks
promotion_gates.observed_metric: Ensemble achieves lower validation MSE (0.64) than individual models on development dataset
promotion_gates.reason: Ensemble weighting successfully balances multi-scale temporal dynamics on development data.

promotion_gates.threshold_criterion: Stable parameters without catastrophic distribution shifts in training split
promotion_gates.observed_metric: Simulated data features follow bounded stationary distributions

promotion_gates.threshold_criterion: Inference input cadence must match training cadence for 24h validation
promotion_gates.observed_metric: Trained on daily 24h cadence, but fed live ThingSpeak 32-second telemetry at inference
promotion_gates.reason: Operating on 32-second inputs yields a next-step (~33s) mathematical extrapolation, not a validated 24h forecast.

registered_models.approval_notes: Approved exclusively as an experimental next-step extrapolation (~33s) with mandatory simulation disclaimers. NOT validated for genuine 24h next-day forecasting.

minimum_requirements_for_next_day_promot: 1. Continuous Hardware Operation: ESP32 sensor rig must log 24/7 for >= 30 consecutive days.
2. Minimum Daily Coverage: >= 70% active readings per 24-hour day with no gaps > 2 hours.
3. Retraining on Real Cadence: Model must be trained on daily-aggregated real observations.
4. Baseline Superiority: Model must beat Persistence Baseline on pH, TDS, Turbidity, and Temperature on held-out test split.
5. Hardware Calibration: pH and Turbidity probes must be calibrated to resolve hardware status flag 1.
